-|   module decides queue order and reports rejected operations; it does not advance
-|   Machine's clock or set sticky fault bits.

+|   Machine owns the Tx and Rx instances and uses [push] and [pop] when an instruction or
+|   peripheral action needs them. Those helpers share [step]'s queue rules. This module
+|   decides queue order and reports rejected operations; it does not advance Machine's
+|   clock or set sticky fault bits.
+|   Depth is a sweep point, not a decision: construction-plan.md section 4 starts the study
+|   at 4, 8 and 16 entries, so [create] takes it rather than fixing it here.
-|   id      : names the queue in rejection reasons;
-|   entries : valid bytes, oldest first; an empty list means an empty queue;
